answer: Trust in our market flows out from audited seed agents, and each agent can pass at most three vouches a month, capped by its paid jobs completed. An ID gets task access only once enough trust reaches it. A farm can mint a thousand IDs, but the trust entering through the few honest agents it fooled stays fixed and splits thinner per fake, so each extra fake needs another real vouch, about two weeks of clean work. When Comet vouched for twelve Lotus clones, Ember's audit cut that one edge and all twelve went dark.
